limitations: Native durable_ms is an upper bound through graceful close and synchronous WAL flush.
Browser IndexedDB uses relaxed durability; browser durable_ms and incremental durable_ms are null.
Exploratory two-collection reset of the original note body timed out after 120s; final edits use unique successive values.
Pinned native provenance includes a dirty-diff hash whose source delta is unavailable.
Near-full APFS laptop, uncontrolled background activity and thermal/cache state; heavy work serialized by shared lock.
Native Core/sender/receiver share one Node process with separate engine stores and actual WebSocket/TCP replication; browser receiver is a separate Chromium process.
